annotations.title: Search possible mentions of a name

description: Search WEIR AI's supported web and social media sources for potential mentions associated with a person's name. The person does not need an existing WEIR identity or license. Results are candidate matches, not verified identification or evidence of infringement. Required: name (a person's full name; the same name checks as weir.ai/search apply). Optional: limit 1-50. When the user has connected their WEIR AI account, results follow their own plan; without a connection some results are hidden (redacted:true). Give the user results_url to see what their plan allows. Never claim a match is the person. [Public, no account needed]

name.description: The person's full name, e.g. 'Jane Doe'.
